global_notes: Independent audit of Claude's 62 Draft evaluations; 10 records held and excluded.
No Power or Role Fit was invented to satisfy an import schema.
Authoritative SCORE-1.0 and RARITY-0.2 calculations are recorded in the audit details companion file.
No character is approved, published or imported into a playable dataset.

evidence.summary: Demonstrated ability to halt Naruto's movement with Shadow Imitation Technique until Nine-Tails Chakra Mode broke the hold.
Bound Naruto's movement with Shadow Imitation Technique before he could escape the temple.
Tracked the escapees' progress through the Thirty-Six Layer Self-Repairing Barrier incident and relayed it to the barrier team.
Used his Byakugan to follow Naruto and Killer B as they escaped the island and reported their progress; Byakugan grants near-360-degree vision and x-ray vision per the page.

Highly demonstrated: former Seven Ninja Swordsman and Anbu who fought Team 7 and allies, defeated Tenten, and overwhelmed Naruto, Lee and Neji until given curry; natural lightning lets him fight continuously without tiring.
Led the Kurosuki Family criminal gang and imposed rule over the Katabami Gold Mine village.
Fought under Hiding in Mist while Ranmaru negated Neji's Byakugan; lured opponents using Karashi and exploited mist-obscured battlefield conditions.
Kiba twin lightning swords, long-distance and area lightning attacks, Rock Avalanche burial, mist-supported ambush, and a single lightning strike that one-shot both Neji and Naruto.
Defended against Lee's attacks with Kiba; used area lightning strikes defensively; could destroy his own body with natural lightning when near death, leaving no trace.
Used Hiding in Mist Technique to blind targets and make them more vulnerable; served as Anbu tasked with finding infiltrating spies.
Water Release mist blanketing and rock avalanche served as battlefield control; Ranmaru acted as his eyes and ears in a mutual support arrangement.
Demonstrated battlefield contribution through full body swap with Kakashi and precise positioning in low-visibility mist to set up a strike on Zabuza.
Integrated into Kakashi's strategy: switched bodies with Kakashi and used sensing to place Kakashi's body behind Zabuza before cancelling the technique.
Used sensor-guided positioning for a surprise strike from behind in thick mist; no assassination is confirmed.
Mind Body Switch Technique (full body exchange rather than consciousness-only transfer) and Sensing Technique used despite absent sight.
Demonstrated use of an Akimichi secret technique against Pain and participation in a four-direction coordinated assault; the group was immediately defeated by Shinra Tensei.
Used Partial Multi-Size Technique (expanding his arm) in the fight against Pain and joined a simultaneous assault from four directions.
Assisted in Kakashi's confrontation with Pain and served on the Island Turtle guard detail to keep Naruto confined.
Some demonstrated utility: aided Inoichi's mind-reading interrogation and assisted in battle against the Giant Crustacean, but no personal finishing technique is shown.
Specific specialist duty: skilled enough to aid Inoichi Yamanaka's Psycho Mind Transmission of Yūdachi to retrieve information from an enemy's mind.
Demonstrated aptitude with Shadow Imitation Technique by helping restrain the Ten-Tails for a short time alongside other Nara.
Shadow Imitation Technique used to restrain the Ten-Tails' shadow briefly in coordination with clan members.
Demonstrated aptitude with Shadow Imitation Technique by helping restrain the Ten-Tails briefly with other Nara.
Shadow Imitation Technique used to restrain the Ten-Tails' tail shadow in coordination with Shikamaru and other Nara.
Demonstrated aptitude with Shadow Imitation Technique by helping restrain the Ten-Tails briefly with other Nara.
Shadow Imitation Technique used to restrain the Ten-Tails in cooperation with Daen, Kasuga and other clan members.
Demonstrated kenjutsu swift slashes and taijutsu that easily defeated multiple Anbu shadow clones; as a reincarnation he engaged Omoi and Kankurō's Sasori puppet and obstructed Sai's team.
Root tantō kenjutsu with swift slashes; explosive clay packed in his reincarnated stomach served as a detonation threat.
Serving as Root support on a surprise attack/diversion; no successful stealth kill is shown.
Served as the short-range combat shinobi of Minato's platoon; his team clashed with Kumogakure's A–B Combo, though no individual hit by Gaku is described.
Specific short-range combat function is stated; no named offensive technique is supplied.
He communicated the retreat decision to Minato.
Primary material demonstrates first aid on the battlefield; Naruto Mobile separately shows taijutsu and good shurikenjutsu skill.
Assisted Nonō and Kabuto in treating Konoha shinobi for money and later aided comrades during the Fourth Shinobi World War.
At least competent in first aid; directly seen performing basic first aid on a comrade during the war.
Anime demonstrates kenjutsu combat against reincarnated Hayate, Anbu apprehension of Sora, and protection duties; manga skill level is not displayed.
Uses Anbu coordination, sealing of corpses, tracking, and a delayed confrontation with Hayate's reincarnation to complete the KIA scroll recovery.
Uses Dance of the Crescent Moon and Hazy Moon Night in kenjutsu, striking with speed and complex movements and piercing reincarnated Hayate.
Anbu membership and catching Sora while he spies in a ceiling are shown, but no named stealth or assassination technique is supplied.
Seals objects and shinobi corpses into scrolls, assists with basic medical care, tracks thieves, and protects Tsunade.
Assists in basic medical care while assigned to the Logistical Support and Medical Division; depth of medical skill is not shown.
One of the most powerful shinobi Kirigakure produced, a Seven Ninja Swordsman, an Akatsuki member, and a lethal Kubikiribōchō wielder with major battle feats.
Meticulous and professional about missions, created formations to synchronize with Itachi, partnered with Itachi on missions, and attempted a sword deflection against Yagura's Tailed Beast Ball.
Wields the regenerative Kubikiribōchō with enough skill and brutality to dye battlefields red, strikes down most of Yagura's hunter-nin, and fights with Water Release clones and mist.
Survived Might Duy's Eight Gates Released Formation; could carry and wield the huge sword for long periods; failed to deflect Yagura's Tailed Beast Ball and was mortally wounded.
As an Akatsuki member and former missing-nin he undertook missions with Itachi, but no specific stealth or assassination technique is described.
Water clones and thick mist provide battlefield control and concealment.
Coordinates with Meizu using a shuriken chain to bind and slice enemies, uses poisoned claws, hides undetected near Konoha's gates, and ambushes Team 7 from water.
Paragon of coordinated attacking with his twin; uses Water Release hiding to surprise the target and has a release mechanism to fight independently if the chain is neutralised.
Retractable shuriken chain can bind and slice targets; poisoned gauntlet claws shred foes.
Skilled in stealth, able to hide right outside Konoha's gates undetected; worked as Zabuza's assassin.
Chain binding restrains enemies; mist/water positioning supports ambush control.
Coordinates with Gōzu using a shared shuriken chain to bind and slice enemies, uses poisoned claws, hides undetected near Konoha's gates, and ambushes Team 7 from water.
Uses coordinated twin attacking and Water Release concealment to surprise opponents; Gōzu's release mechanism permits independent fighting if the chain is neutralised.
Retractable shuriken chain can bind and slice targets; poisoned gauntlet claws shred foes.
Skilled in stealth, capable of hiding right outside Konoha's gates without being noticed; worked as Zabuza's assassin.
Chain binding restrains enemies; puddle positioning supports ambush control.
Took part in a coordinated four-direction assault on the Deva Path of Pain alongside Kakashi's group, but was defeated immediately by Shinra Tensei.
Used Wind Release: Great Breakthrough in the assault; his clan researches concealed weapons and his mouth-fired kunai are stronger than hand-thrown ones.
Despite remaining a genin his whole career, he mastered all Eight Gates over twenty years and used them to fend off the entire Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.
Taught the Eight Gates kinjutsu to his son Guy and inspired later generations; protected Ebisu and Genma alongside Guy.
Eight Gates Released Formation; in the anime his efforts killed four members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.
Extensively trained body with high stamina and physique sufficient to withstand the Eight Gates; protected his son and teammates from a far stronger group.
Rescued Guy, Ebisu and Genma from the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.

Physical speed and strength let him close on Komaza in a blink, restrain him with one arm and knock him into a wall; later helped distract the Animal Path and (anime) assisted against the Giant Snake-Tailed Chameleon.
Keen observation as examiner, asserting elite chūnin would not miss any cheating; monitored and tracked examinees precisely.
One-arm restraint and wall impact against Komaza; no named offensive technique.
Aided Inoichi Yamanaka's Psycho Mind Transmission of Yūdachi and helped distract the Animal Path so analysis could continue.
Led a battalion of Iwagakure shinobi against Konoha's and almost broke through Konoha's defences before Minato Namikaze defeated him.
Demonstrated battlefield leadership of an Iwa battalion during the Third Shinobi World War.
Pushed an offensive nearly to the point of breaking Konoha's defensive line; also directed comrades to toy with surviving Konoha-nin.
No personal combat is shown; his demonstrated contribution is strategic counsel during the Kazekage Rescue operation and calm assessment in a crisis.
Long-serving head of the Suna Council, highly revered in Sunagakure; joined a support team during the Kazekage Rescue Mission and urged measured conduct.

Strong analytical mind used in past shinobi wars; warned Temari and other Suna-nin not to panic or rush blindly into enemy territory, and recounted the chaos after the Third Kazekage's disappearance to prevent a repeat.
Supported the Kazekage Rescue Team, supplied historical intelligence about the Third Kazekage and argued for patience to avoid total annihilation.
Demonstrated restraint utility: halted the Eight-Tails' movements with Lightning Release and helped hold it down with a weighted chain; was ultimately killed by the beast.
In the anime, rallied teammates to continue restraining the Eight-Tails because failure would mean Kumogakure's destruction; no other command role demonstrated.
Used a chain with a weight on the end to hold down the Eight-Tails; anime Lightning Release stopped the beast's movement for the team's subdual effort.
Baki's right-hand man who helped mount the pursuit after Gaara's abduction.
Formed/deployed a pursuit unit on Baki's orders during Gaara's abduction and went out with it to find Kankurō.
Concrete mission function: organized a pursuit team and coordinated with Baki before departure; no tracking method named.
Joined a four-direction simultaneous assault on the Deva Path alongside Kakashi's group and was immediately defeated by Shinra Tensei.
Manga: wielded a collapsible kusarigama; anime: wielded a collapsible kama; participated in a coordinated attack from four directions.
Attempted to defend Konoha's entrance against Orochimaru's giant snakes with little effect and later assisted against the revived shinobi during the second invasion.
Shouted orders to intercept Furido's squad head-on; Genma Shiranui reprimanded him for sending men into the fray that way.
Anime: infiltrated an underground Akatsuki hideout as a Nijū Shōtai member and searched it, reporting no findings.
Reported intelligence after the hideout infiltration and escorted a hostile Karin into the Intelligence Division.
Fought the Anbu guarding Hiruzen, who was a disguised Kakashi, during the assassination attempt and survived the encounter even though the mission failed.
Disguised as a foreign shinobi as part of the mission to assassinate Hiruzen; the disguise and approach are demonstrated, the kill is not.
Sunagakure shinobi who defended against Toroi's shuriken and sealed the regenerating reincarnated enemy.
Cloth Binding Technique restrains opponents; sealing tags provide the finishing containment.
Concrete demonstrated support/control: bound and sealed Toroi using Cloth Binding Technique and a Sealing Tag.
Samurai mercenary who executed Kaiza with a slash and later defeated several Naruto shadow clones in the anime.
Worked as Gatō's bodyguard alongside Waraji and later led a group of kidnappers in the anime; unknown: formal command role.
Iaidō provides a one-move killing sword strike; anime shows swordplay against shadow clones and a one-punch knock-out of Tsunami.
Iaidō is explicitly a one-move assassination-style strike; no stealth infiltration is described.
A highly capable fighter who defended and countered simultaneous assaults by Hidan and Kakuzu for a period before being overwhelmed.
Served as head monk of the Fire Temple and looked after and trained Sora; tactical command in combat unknown.
Combined barrier defense, taijutsu counters and sealing; arranged Sora's transfer to Team Yamato for monitoring.
Mastered the Fire Temple ultimate technique Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder; taijutsu counters are shown against two Akatsuki members.
Created a powerful Sealed Iron Wall barrier around the Fire Temple and withstood Hidan and Kakuzu's joint assault briefly.
Barrier ninjutsu protected the temple; fūinjutsu was used with other monks to suppress Sora's demonic chakra.
Samurai mercenary who cut through a wall in one fluid motion, killed a giant boar and defeated several shadow clones in the anime.
Iaijutsu and kenjutsu with enough force to bisect a wall and a giant boar in single strikes.
Iai-nuki from a seated posture is an assassination-style quick draw; no covert infiltration is shown.
First jinchūriki of Shukaku with strong chakra reserves, but the page states he never mastered Shukaku's power himself.
Contained Shukaku for a long period without a cage and resisted the mental degradation associated with the beast.
Anime shows sealing Shukaku into a tea kettle; also credited with moulding currents and a Dharma Power Sealing Technique by Hōichi.
Confronted Kisame alongside Killer B, landed a strike opportunity and rushed to aid B; the page notes limited combat ability in a game profile.
Observed that Samehada was absorbing B's chakra and accounted for it when assessing the fight.
Wielded an enormous axe many times his size with ease and attacked Kisame using the Yosaku Cut.
Battlefield observation identified the enemy weapon's chakra-absorption effect.
Diagnosed Lee's career-ending injuries (chapter 87 pages 5-6 lead).
Anime shows genjutsu-based memory restoration attempts; first aid was given to the Mizuki-injured group.
Concrete demonstration: examined Rock Lee after Gaara fight and determined the injuries could not be fully healed; provided first aid in the anime.
Sensor-type shinobi who survived Madara's assault on the Fourth Division and continued tracking enemies; no personal attack shown.
Concrete specialist capability: detected Madara Uchiha and Mū and alerted other shinobi on the battlefield.
Attempted to assassinate Pain alongside two other Amegakure remnants; the outcome is not confirmed.
Said to be very skilled in infiltration and actually infiltrated Amegakure with two others to attempt Pain's assassination.
Identified Jiraiya's message as non-standard and set the team on the correct decryption path (chapter 406 page 5 lead).
Head of the Konoha Cryptanalysis Team, directing day-to-day division work under the Hokage; no field command shown.
Analysed the circumstances of Jiraiya's message and redirected Shikamaru toward someone who knew Jiraiya personally.
Concrete specialist capability: recognised at a glance that Jiraiya's code matched no known Konoha algorithm.
Civilian fisherman; Tazuna states it took Gatō's entire gang to stop one man, but no technique or fight is described.
Exceptional stamina and physical resolve; withstood the gang's attack long enough to be publicly executed as a warning.
Closed the gate alone to save the village area from flooding.
Joined a simultaneous four-direction assault on the Deva Path of Pain as part of Kakashi's confrontation; the group was immediately defeated by Shinra Tensei.
Main fighting style uses ninja tools: a special shuriken launcher stored in a scroll that bombards the enemy with a volley of shuriken in an instant.
Twenty years of ferryman experience across the Land of Waves waterways (First Databook lead).
Concrete specialist capability: ferried Team 7 and Tazuna to the edge of the Land of Waves using local waterway knowledge.
Led a squad to capture the infiltrating Sasuke Uchiha, launched an attack that was repelled, then charged him and was quickly cut down.
Led a squad under Urakaku's orders to seek out and capture Sasuke.

Two-sword kenjutsu preference plus chakra channeling through swords for extended reach/cutting power and a long-range attack (Samurai Sabre Technique/Flash); the launched attack was repelled by Sasuke's sword.
Analysis Team shinobi who helped distract the Animal Path during Pain's assault; no personal attack described.
Concrete demonstrated support: aided Inoichi Yamanaka's Psycho Mind Transmission of Yūdachi.
First to detect Sasori and Deidara approaching Sunagakure despite jōnin and Anbu also being present.
Served as an early-warning sentinel at the village gate using exceptional eyesight.
Noted as the greatest photographer in Konohagakure; was charged with photographing Team Minato years earlier.
Jōnin instructor who placed village youth inside a barrier during the Nine-Tails attack; no combat fight is described.
Oversees training of Konoha genin and chūnin and directed youths to safety during the attack.
Barrier placement is a concrete protective support action; no other chakra technique is shown.
Shown closing with a reincarnated Akatsuki shinobi (Gari) as a Third Division fighter, using his large-fist taijutsu; the attempt failed when he was blown apart before connecting.
Uses colossal fists as weapons in taijutsu; attempted a strike on Gari in battle.
No direct combat action demonstrated; he monitored the battlefield from HQ as a sensor.
Erected an immense Sensing Barrier using Water Release together with others' assistance, allowing monitoring of the war zone.
First to recognise the significance of Sunagakure sending its fastest bird, which reported Gaara's kidnapping.
Concrete aviary mission function: received Suna's message via Takamaru, routed it to Yurika, and flagged that something serious had happened.
Co-identified black receivers on the Animal Path, a key intelligence result after Pain's assault.
Analytical contribution: co-determined that the black rods on Pain's Animal Path were black receivers rather than body piercings.
Analysis Team member performing medical investigation of a captured enemy body alongside Shizune and Kumadori.
Great medical ninjutsu knowledge is inferred from being selected for Shizune's analysis team; the concrete demonstrated act is the autopsy finding about black receivers.
Co-identified black receivers during the autopsy of Pain's Animal Path.
Analytical contribution: co-determined that the rods on Pain's Animal Path were black receivers, not piercings.
Analysis Team member assisting Shizune with medical investigation of a captured enemy body.
Great medical ninjutsu knowledge is inferred from team selection; the demonstrated act is the autopsy finding about black receivers.
Decoded the report of Gaara's abduction by Akatsuki and passed it to Tsunade (told her directly in manga, handed her the message in anime).
Converted an intercepted coded message into actionable intelligence about Gaara's kidnapping.
Concrete cryptology mission function: decoded Sunagakure's message delivered via the Konoha Aviary.
Part of the medical effort that saved Kankurō alongside Sakura, after his own treatment attempt failed.
Assisted Sakura Haruno in treating the poisoned Kankurō after his own and Sekka's initial treatment failed.
Talented medical-nin: attempted to treat Sasori's poison on Kankurō with Sekka, then aided Sakura's successful poison extraction and antidote work.
Saved numerous lives in the past per the databook lead; took part in the medical effort that saved Kankurō.
Attempted to treat the poisoned Kankurō with Ryōkan and later assisted Sakura Haruno's treatment effort.
Talented Sunagakure medical-nin said to have saved numerous lives; demonstrated treating Sasori's poison on Kankurō, initially without success, then aiding Sakura's extraction and antidote work.
